section_summary.extract_value: This section details Experiment 2, which investigated the relationships between divergent thinking, real-life creative achievement, attentional flexibility, and cognitive control. Participants completed an oddball task, a divergent thinking test, a survey on real-life creative accomplishments, and an intelligence test. The experiment aimed to test hypotheses regarding divergent thinking's association with attentional flexibility and cognitive control, and creative achievement's link with cognitive control.
